§3§lRings and slots§r
With Baubles-Expanded installed, the ring row expands to §110§r slots; without it, §12§r slots are used. Seven functional rings are rare drops from §17§r kinds of structure chest. Windrider is obtained by crafting.

§3§lBundled trade sources§r
Default prices are §18§r Shimmering Coins each for Distant Grasp, Skywalk and Ironheart; §112§r each for Dragon's Breath, Mountainbreaker and Tempest; and §112§r Shimmering Coins plus Delighted Meals ×§116§r for Gluttony. Servers can change these trades.

§3§lCompletion§r
Read the slot and ring-source information, then tick the checkbox. Later quests explain each ring's effects and retrieval requirements.
